note.zh: 在 Codex CLI 中使用 DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813（xhigh 思考配额）多轮迭代完成的 Vite + React 18 + TypeScript + Three.js 工程。开发期间安装依赖、运行 TypeScript 检查与生产构建，并用无头浏览器检查首屏和 Canvas；修复了地图导航路径与墙体碰撞不一致的问题。源码未在提交后修改，公开仓排除 node_modules 与 dist。
note.en: A Vite + React 18 + TypeScript + Three.js project completed in Codex CLI with DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 at xhigh thinking effort through iterative development. Dependencies were installed, TypeScript checks and the production build were run, and a headless browser was used to verify the first screen and canvas. Map navigation paths and wall-collision mismatches were fixed. Source files are included unmodified after submission; node_modules and dist are excluded from the public repository.
